title: Chapters
intro: Mark where each part of the episode starts. Podcast apps show them, and 3Speak lists them in the description. They stay with your recording when you cut it. Shortcut: <kbd>M</kbd> adds one at the playhead.
empty: No chapters yet. Move the playhead to where a part starts and add one.
leftOut: Chapters less than a second apart, or at the very end, are left out of the export.
tipZero: Tip: many apps expect the first chapter at 0:00.

suggest.title: Suggestions
suggest.findTitle: Find where parts likely start: new topics, long pauses, scene changes
suggest.withTranscript: With a transcript (the Transcript button), suggestions also follow the topics and get titles from what is said.
suggest.none: No clear places found. The show may be short, or its parts flow into each other.
